title: Adopting the compiler step by step

slides.text: Don't flip the switch on everything at once 🪜
slides.say: In a big existing app, you can roll out React Compiler bit by bit. Start small to build confidence.
Approach one: Babel overrides. Apply the compiler plugin to one directory, then expand to more folders over time.
Approach two: annotation mode. Only components and hooks that opt in with use memo get compiled.
Approach three: runtime gating. The compiled code is wrapped in a check. If your flag function returns true, the optimized version runs. Otherwise, the original code runs. Great for A B tests.

slides.text: Hit a problem? Exclude that component with "use no memo", fix the Rules of React violations, then continue.
slides.say: If something breaks, exclude that component with use no memo for now, fix the rules of React issues, and keep going.
